name: fusion-jev
description: Recoverable compact coding evidence and bounded Jev choices

interface.shortDescription: Grounded evidence with recoverable compact output.
defaultPrompt: Use Fusion through fusion_assist first for every supported routine task, including known small reads, searches, Git checks and commands. Configured Jev selects validated actions before Fusion gathers evidence. Do not substitute fusion_inspect for normal delegation; it is an explicit diagnostic or escalation/failure fallback. fusion_evidence recovers exact receipts only when needed.

For exact commands, call fusion_assist with task, absolute root and command:{program,argv}; execute its returned execution plan through fusion-jev run -- program argv... if installed globally, else npx -y fusion-jev@0.3.1 run -- program argv... (PowerShell: quote '--'; --raw for short output). Existing authorization and host permissions apply; do not ask for extra Jev access approval. Continue bounded assistance when needed. Host owns reasoning, edits and verification. Native tools only on unsupported work or explicit failure.
